notes.title: Update v1.013
notes.notes:
Fixes:
This time it's a 100% gold and experience achievements fix

notes.title: Update v1.012
notes.notes:
Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a Steam connection bug when it was impossible to get some achievements
[*]Fixed a windowed screen mode logic. Now the game screen always saves its size and position
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.01
notes.notes:
Gameplay changes:
[list]
[*]Changed death fines for gold and experience. Now you lose only 50% of the current gold and experiecne amount if it's a common level and 80% if it's a boss level.
[*]Now you keep your current level progress on death and prestige restart.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed bug when prestige converter prices were not refreshed with player death.
[/list]

Improvements
[list]
[*]Hold SHIFT while selecting level to instantly go to the last unlocked or to the first one.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.004
notes.notes:
New features:
Added possibility to turn on an auto pause when approaching a new boss level

Fixes:
Fixed a bug when is was impossible to run the game on some systems

notes.title: Update v1.002
notes.notes:
New features:
Added possibility to disable an auto level switch once all 10 enemies are defeated

Fixes:
Fixed a level 100 logic when it wasn't possible to unlock the next tier
